page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac and Greek words are rendered only approximately; the Syriac and some Hebrew letters are too faint or too close to the scan to be read with certainty, so the Hebrew and Syriac forms above are best-effort and marked illegible where I could not read them letter by letter. Small raised marks (y, ρ) over Syriac words are reference marks and are not transcribed. Show-through text from the reverse of the leaf is ignored.
